title: ships wheel bath mat
text: ships wheel bath mat. I purchased this along with a couple of the same type with different prints.  A real disappointment.  They come folded and the creases don't come out even with washing and drying.  Eh.  The backing does have some dots that help make it less slippery.  To be honest, I'm going back to the regular bath mat with rubber backing.  At least they lay flat and don't look folded when down.  Eh.
